newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia peso drifts down in quiet markets.
newsitem.headline: Colombia peso drifts down in quiet markets.

text.p: Colombia's peso drifted down 0.5 peso to 1,074 per dollar in quiet markets, interbank traders said.
"There was a bit of speculation by banks but there was little real demand for greenbacks from industry because of the public holiday in the United States," a trader said.

Another trader said the session opened with banks building up their dollar positions after selling Friday to make up a shortfall in pesos. The state sector then began selling greenbacks later in the session which prevented a bigger rise in the dollar, the trader added.
Dealers reported 244 operations worth a total $99 million -- about half the daily average. The peso opened at 1,076.8, hit an intraday high of 1,072.6 and sank to an intraday low of 1,078.9.
